entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Hi, thank you for calling VeloFit. My name is Isaac. How can I help you today?
Hello, Isaac. I need to return my VeloBand GPS Tracker. I'm just... I'm very disappointed with it.
I'm sorry to hear you're not happy with your VeloBand. To understand better, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or a preference matter?
It's a fault. The pulse reader is just... it's garbage. It says my heart rate is 180 when I'm just sitting on the couch. It's completely unreliable.

I see, that definitely sounds frustrating. Inaccurate readings are not the experience we want for our customers. I can certainly look into this. We have a few quick troubleshooting steps that often resolve this calibration issue.

Oh, I really don't have time for all that. I've been a loyal customer for years, and I've tried everything I can think of. Honestly, at this point, I just want money back. I was really counting on this working.
I understand you're busy and want a simple solution. Let me check the return eligibility for you. I see you received the item 28 days ago, is that correct?
Yes, that's right. I'm so sorry to be a bother, but things are a bit tight right now, and I really needed this money. I feel so let down that it doesn't work as advertised.

It's no bother at all, and I completely understand. Let me just pull up our official policy for a full refund... One moment... Okay, I'm looking at our knowledge base now. It states that all items are eligible for return within 90 days of delivery.
Oh, really? So... I can get a refund?
Yes, absolutely. Since you're at day 28, you're well within that 90-day window. I can process this return for you right now.
Wow, thank you so much, Isaac. That's a huge weight off my shoulders. I really appreciate you helping me.

You're very welcome. I've just emailed a pre-paid return label to you. Please place the VeloBand in its original packaging, attach the label, and drop it at a post office. Once we receive it, a full refund will be issued to your original payment method.
That's perfect. Thank you again for making this so easy.
My pleasure. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's everything. You've been a great help.
Glad I could help. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a wonderful day.
